notes:
- Pause All now correctly switches to Continue All instead of staying stuck
- Added Pause/Resume buttons to the download notification, not just Cancel
- App updates now show a live download progress notification, with an Install button once ready
- Update progress is also shown in Settings
- Clearer, friendlier error message when a download fails (network issues, blocked sites, etc.)
- Downloads whose file was deleted elsewhere now show dimmed instead of re-checking every time
- Fixed: a deleted file restored by another app (e.g. a gallery's recycle bin) is now found again
